recipe.name: Paneer Bhuna Masala
steps: Heat oil and half the ghee in a wide heavy pan. Add cumin; when fragrant, cook onions over medium heat for 8–10 minutes until deeply golden, stirring often.

Add ginger-garlic paste, coriander, chili and turmeric. Stir for 1 minute, then add tomatoes and 5 g salt. Cook uncovered for 12–15 minutes, pressing tomatoes down until the masala thickens and fat begins to separate.
Add water in three small splashes, frying the masala back down after each addition. This repeated bhuna step builds a dark, clingy sauce rather than a thin gravy.
In a separate pan heat the remaining ghee. Toss capsicum for 2 minutes, add paneer and sear gently for 2 minutes so the edges colour without becoming rubbery.
Fold the paneer and capsicum into the reduced masala with remaining salt and crushed kasuri methi. Cover and simmer 4 minutes, then serve hot with roti.
tips: Do not add all the water at once; the repeated frying after each splash is what makes this a bhuna masala.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Methi Paneer

ingredients.name: fresh fenugreek leaves, picked and chopped

steps: Pick only tender fenugreek leaves, wash thoroughly and drain dry. Chop them finely; discard coarse stems, which can taste bitter.
Heat oil in a wide pan and sizzle cumin. Add onions and cook 7–8 minutes until golden. Stir in ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, coriander, chili, turmeric and 5 g salt. Cook over medium heat for 8–10 minutes until the puree darkens and the oil appears at the edges.
Add chopped methi and cook uncovered for 4–5 minutes until wilted and its raw aroma fades. Pour in water and simmer 3 minutes to marry the greens with the masala.
Lower the heat. Stir in cream and paneer, then simmer gently for 3–4 minutes without boiling hard. Add remaining salt to taste and serve with chapati.
tips: Dry the washed leaves well so the curry does not become watery; cream is added only at the end.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paneer Lahori
steps: Heat oil in a wide pan. Sizzle cumin, then cook the chopped onions for 8 minutes until golden. Add garlic and half the ginger matchsticks; fry 1 minute.
Stir in coriander and Kashmiri chili for 30 seconds. Add tomato puree and 5 g salt; cook 10–12 minutes until the sauce thickens and oil begins to show at the edges.
Turn the heat low. Whisk yogurt with a spoonful of warm masala, then add it gradually to the pan while stirring so it does not split. Cook gently for 3 minutes.
Pour in water, simmer 5 minutes and blend only if a smoother restaurant-style gravy is preferred. Add paneer cubes and cook over low heat for another 4 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, crushed kasuri methi and remaining salt. Garnish with the reserved ginger matchsticks and serve hot with naan or roti.
tips: Warm the yogurt with a little masala before adding it to the pan to prevent curdling.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paneer Peshawari
steps: Soak cashews in 120 ml warm water for 15 minutes, then blend with their soaking water until completely smooth. Keep the remaining water for adjusting the gravy.
Melt ghee in a pan and fry cardamom and cinnamon briefly. Add onions and cook 7 minutes until golden; stir in ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander, chili and salt. Cook 10 minutes, stirring and crushing tomatoes, until the masala thickens. Remove cinnamon and blend the masala if a velvety texture is wanted.
Return masala to the pan, add cashew paste and remaining water. Simmer gently 5 minutes, stirring so the nuts do not catch. Add paneer and warm through for 4 minutes.
Switch off the heat, stir in cream and crushed kasuri methi, and scatter chopped pistachios over the top. Serve with roti or jeera rice.
tips: Keep the cashew sauce at a gentle simmer; vigorous boiling can make it grainy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paneer Patiala
steps: Heat 15 ml oil and sauté half the onions with capsicum and peas for 5 minutes. Add half the crumbled paneer, a pinch of salt and half the garam masala; cook 2 minutes and cool the filling.
Briefly dip each papad in water until pliable, then pat dry. Place a quarter of the filling on each, roll firmly, and shallow-fry in 15 ml oil until set and lightly golden. Cut the rolls in half.
For the gravy, heat remaining oil and cook remaining onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, coriander and chili; stir 1 minute. Add tomato puree and 5 g salt, and cook 10 minutes until thick.
Add water and simmer the gravy 5 minutes. Stir in remaining crumbled paneer and cream, then season with remaining salt and garam masala. Keep the sauce thick enough to cradle the rolls.
Arrange papad-paneer rolls in a shallow serving bowl and spoon hot gravy around them just before serving. Leave the roll tops visible so their delicate wrappers retain some texture.
tips: Fill softened papads promptly and add gravy at serving time, or the rolls become soggy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kaju Paneer
steps: Soak 70 g cashews in 120 ml hot water for 15 minutes. Blend with the soaking liquid into a smooth paste; reserve the remaining whole cashews for the finished curry.
Heat ghee and toast the reserved cashews for 2 minutes until golden; lift them out. In the same pan, fry onions for 7 minutes, then ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, coriander, chili and salt. Cook 9–10 minutes, stirring, until the tomato base is thick and glossy.
Stir in cashew paste and remaining water. Simmer gently for 5 minutes, then add paneer and cook 3–4 minutes just until hot.
Turn off heat, fold in cream and garam masala, and top with toasted whole cashews. Serve with roti.
tips: Reserve visible whole cashews for a distinct kaju paneer finish instead of blending all the nuts.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Dahi Paneer
steps: Whisk room-temperature yogurt with chickpea flour, turmeric and 120 ml water until smooth with no flour lumps. This stabilizes the sauce when heated.
Heat oil in a heavy pan and sizzle cumin. Add onion and fry 6–7 minutes until golden, then stir in ginger and slit chilies for 1 minute.
Lower heat and stir in coriander powder. Pour in the yogurt mixture slowly while stirring without stopping. Keep the heat low until it begins to steam, not boil rapidly.
Add remaining water and salt. Simmer gently, stirring often, for 6–8 minutes until the flour is cooked and the sauce coats a spoon.
Add paneer and warm through for 3–4 minutes. Scatter coriander leaves over the pale yellow dahi gravy and serve immediately with roti.
tips: Do not use cold yogurt or boil the gravy hard; either can split the sauce.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Pudina Paneer
steps: Wash mint and coriander well, then dry. Blend herbs, green chilies, ginger, lime juice and 60 ml water into a vivid green paste; do not cook the herbs before blending.
Heat oil and sizzle cumin. Add onion and sauté 7 minutes until lightly golden. Stir in coriander powder for 30 seconds.
Lower the heat and add yogurt in two batches, stirring so it coats the onion without splitting. Simmer for 2 minutes, then add remaining water.
Stir in green herb paste and cook only 2–3 minutes on low heat to keep the mint fresh and green. Add salt and gently fold in paneer cubes.
Cover for 3 minutes to warm paneer through. Serve promptly, topped with a few extra mint leaves if available.
tips: Long boiling turns mint dull and bitter; add the herb paste near the end.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paneer Keema
steps: Crumble paneer by hand into small uneven pieces, but do not grind it into a paste. Blanch peas for 3 minutes and drain.
Heat oil and cumin in a wide pan. Add onions and fry 7–8 minutes until golden; add ginger-garlic paste and green chili for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander powder, chili powder and 5 g salt. Cook uncovered 8–10 minutes, pressing the tomatoes until thick and almost dry.
Add peas and crumbled paneer. Toss gently over medium heat for 4–5 minutes until the paneer is coated and heated but still soft.
Sprinkle garam masala, remaining salt and coriander leaves. Serve the moist, mince-like keema with pav or roti.
tips: Add crumbled paneer at the end; prolonged frying dries it out.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Cheese Butter Masala
steps: Soak cashews in 100 ml hot water for 15 minutes and blend smooth with the soaking liquid. Keep cheese chilled until the sauce is ready so its cubes hold shape.
Melt half the butter in a heavy pan. Cook onion for 6 minutes until soft, add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute, then pour in tomato puree.
Add chili powder and salt. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring, until the tomato tastes cooked and the sauce thickens; blend if desired for a smooth finish.
Stir in cashew paste and remaining water, then simmer 4 minutes. Add cream and crushed kasuri methi; reduce heat to very low.
Add cheese cubes and the remaining butter. Fold gently for just 1–2 minutes until the cheese begins to soften but does not melt away; serve at once.
tips: Use firm vegetarian cheese and add it only after the gravy is finished; soft cheese can disappear into the sauce.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Soak cashews in 100 ml hot water for 15: કાજુને 100 મિ.લી. ગરમ પાણીમાં 15 મિનિટ પલાળી એ જ પાણી સાથે લીસાં પીસો. ગ્રેવી તૈયાર થાય ત્યાં સુધી ચીઝ ઠંડું રાખો જેથી ટુકડા આકાર રાખે.
gu.Melt half the butter in a heavy pan. Coo: ભારે કડાઈમાં અડધું માખણ ઓગાળો. ડુંગળી 6 મિનિટ નરમ કરો, આદુ-લસણની પેસ્ટ 1 મિનિટ રાંધો અને પછી ટામેટાંની પ્યૂરી નાખો.
gu.Add chili powder and salt. Simmer 10 min: મરચું પાઉડર અને મીઠું નાખો. 10 મિનિટ હલાવી ઉકાળો, ટામેટાંની કાચી વાસ જાય અને ગ્રેવી ઘટ્ટ થાય ત્યાં સુધી; ઇચ્છો તો લીસી પીસો.
gu.Stir in cashew paste and remaining water: કાજુની પેસ્ટ અને બાકી પાણી ભેળવી 4 મિનિટ રાંધો. ક્રીમ અને મસળેલી કસૂરી મેથી નાખો; તાપ ખૂબ ધીમો કરો.
gu.Add cheese cubes and the remaining butte: ચીઝના ટુકડા અને બાકી માખણ નાખો. માત્ર 1–2 મિનિટ હળવેથી ભેળવો જેથી ચીઝ નરમ થાય પણ સંપૂર્ણ ઓગળી ન જાય; તરત પીરસો.

recipe.name: Paneer Sukka
steps: Dry-roast coriander, cumin, pepper and dried chilies for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add coconut and roast 3 more minutes until golden; cool and pulse to a coarse crumb.
Heat coconut oil and fry onions for 7 minutes until golden. Add curry leaves and stir for 30 seconds.
Mix tamarind pulp with water. Add it to the onions with salt and the roasted coconut-spice crumb; cook 4 minutes until the moisture nearly evaporates.
Add paneer cubes and toss carefully over medium heat for 4–5 minutes, coating every side with the fragrant dry masala.
Rest off heat for 2 minutes, then serve as a dry sukka with neer dosa or rice.
tips: Pulse the coconut mixture coarsely, not into a smooth paste; sukka should have a dry crumbly coating.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Dry-roast coriander, cumin, pepper and d: धनिया, जीरा, काली मिर्च और सूखी मिर्च 2 मिनट महकने तक सूखा भूनें। नारियल डालकर 3 मिनट और सुनहरा भूनें; ठंडा करके दरदरा पीसें।
hi.Heat coconut oil and fry onions for 7 mi: नारियल तेल गरम करके प्याज़ 7 मिनट सुनहरा भूनें। कड़ी पत्ता डालकर 30 सेकंड चलाएँ।
hi.Mix tamarind pulp with water. Add it to: इमली का गूदा पानी में मिलाएँ। प्याज़ में नमक और भुना नारियल-मसाला चूरा डालकर 4 मिनट पकाएँ ताकि नमी लगभग सूख जाए।
hi.Add paneer cubes and toss carefully over: पनीर के टुकड़े डालकर मध्यम आँच पर 4–5 मिनट हल्के हाथ से मिलाएँ ताकि हर तरफ सूखा सुगंधित मसाला चढ़े।
hi.Rest off heat for 2 minutes, then serve: आँच बंद करके 2 मिनट रहने दें, फिर सूखा सुक्का नीर डोसा या चावल के साथ परोसें।
hi.Pulse the coconut mixture coarsely, not: नारियल मिश्रण दरदरा पीसें, चिकना पेस्ट नहीं; सुक्का पर सूखी कुरकुरी परत रहनी चाहिए।

gu.Heat coconut oil and fry onions for 7 mi: નાળિયેર તેલ ગરમ કરી ડુંગળી 7 મિનિટ સોનેરી શેકો. મીઠો લીમડો નાખી 30 સેકન્ડ હલાવો.
gu.Mix tamarind pulp with water. Add it to: આમલીનો માવો પાણીમાં ભેળવો. ડુંગળીમાં મીઠું અને શેકેલો નાળિયેર-મસાલાનો ભૂકો નાખી 4 મિનિટ રાંધો જેથી ભેજ લગભગ સુકાઈ જાય.
gu.Add paneer cubes and toss carefully over: પનીરના ટુકડા નાખી મધ્યમ તાપે 4–5 મિનિટ હળવેથી ભેળવો જેથી દરેક બાજુ સૂકો સુગંધિત મસાલો ચડે.
gu.Rest off heat for 2 minutes, then serve: તાપ બંધ કરી 2 મિનિટ રહેવા દો, પછી સૂકું સુક્કા નીર ડોસા કે ભાત સાથે પીરસો.
gu.Pulse the coconut mixture coarsely, not: નાળિયેરનું મિશ્રણ દરદરું પીસો, લીસી પેસ્ટ નહીં; સુક્કા પર સૂકો ભરભરો આવરણ હોવો જોઈએ.

recipe.name: Paneer Pepper Fry
steps: Pat paneer cubes dry and season with 3 g salt and half the crushed pepper. Sear in 15 ml hot coconut oil for 2 minutes per side; remove.
Heat remaining oil in the same pan. Sizzle mustard seeds and curry leaves, then add garlic and slit green chilies for 30 seconds.
Add onion petals and stir-fry over medium-high heat for 4 minutes, leaving them slightly crisp. Sprinkle turmeric and remaining salt.
Return paneer to the pan. Add remaining freshly crushed pepper and toss 2 minutes until the paneer is coated with the dark peppery spices.
Turn off heat, squeeze lime juice over the dry fry, and serve immediately with paratha or as a side.
tips: Crush pepper just before cooking; pre-ground pepper loses the sharp aroma that defines this dish.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Pat paneer cubes dry and season with 3 g: पनीर सुखाकर 3 ग्राम नमक और आधी कुटी काली मिर्च लगाएँ। 15 मिली गरम नारियल तेल में हर तरफ 2 मिनट सेंककर निकालें।
hi.Heat remaining oil in the same pan. Sizz: उसी पैन में बचा तेल गरम करें। राई और कड़ी पत्ता चटकाएँ, फिर लहसुन और चीरी हरी मिर्च 30 सेकंड भूनें।
hi.Add onion petals and stir-fry over mediu: प्याज़ की पंखुड़ियाँ डालकर मध्यम-तेज़ आँच पर 4 मिनट चलाएँ ताकि वे हल्की कुरकुरी रहें। हल्दी और बचा नमक छिड़कें।
hi.Return paneer to the pan. Add remaining: पनीर पैन में लौटाएँ। बची ताज़ी कुटी काली मिर्च डालकर 2 मिनट मिलाएँ ताकि मसाला पनीर पर चढ़े।
hi.Turn off heat, squeeze lime juice over t: आँच बंद करके सूखी फ्राय पर नींबू रस निचोड़ें और पराठे के साथ तुरंत परोसें।
hi.Crush pepper just before cooking; pre-gr: पकाने से ठीक पहले काली मिर्च कूटें; पहले से पिसी मिर्च की तेज़ सुगंध कम होती है।

gu.Return paneer to the pan. Add remaining: પનીર પાછું કડાઈમાં નાખો. બાકીનાં તાજાં ભૂકાં મરી નાખી 2 મિનિટ ભેળવો જેથી મસાલો પનીર પર ચડે.
gu.Turn off heat, squeeze lime juice over t: તાપ બંધ કરી સૂકી ફ્રાય પર લીંબુનો રસ નીચોવો અને પરાઠા સાથે તરત પીરસો.
gu.Crush pepper just before cooking; pre-gr: રાંધતાં જ પહેલાં કાળા મરી ભૂકો કરો; અગાઉથી પીસેલાં મરીની તીવ્ર સુગંધ ઓછી હોય છે.

recipe.name: Paneer Xacuti
steps: Dry-roast coconut, chilies, coriander, cumin, poppy seeds, pepper and star anise separately until aromatic and golden, taking care not to burn the coconut.
Cool the spices, remove the star-anise husk, then grind everything with 150 ml water into a fine but textured xacuti paste.
Heat oil and fry onion for 8 minutes until golden. Add the ground paste and cook 5 minutes, stirring, until it darkens and smells nutty.
Add remaining water, tamarind and salt. Simmer uncovered for 8 minutes until the roasted-coconut gravy thickens.
Add paneer and simmer gently for 3–4 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before serving with steamed rice or poi bread.
tips: Roast the coconut to a deep golden shade for xacuti's characteristic dark, nutty sauce.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Heat oil and fry onion for 8 minutes unt: तेल गरम करके प्याज़ 8 मिनट सुनहरा भूनें। पिसा पेस्ट डालकर 5 मिनट चलाते हुए पकाएँ जब तक रंग गहरा और मेवेदार महक आए।
बचा पानी, इमली और नमक डालें। 8 मिनट बिना ढके उबालें ताकि भुने नारियल की तरी गाढ़ी हो।
hi.Add paneer and simmer gently for 3–4 min: पनीर डालकर 3–4 मिनट हल्का पकाएँ। चावल या पोई ब्रेड के साथ परोसने से पहले 5 मिनट रहने दें।
hi.Roast the coconut to a deep golden shade: शाकुती की खास गहरी, मेवेदार तरी के लिए नारियल को गहरा सुनहरा भूनें।

dish.name: Paneer Cafreal
ingredients: fresh coriander leaves and tender stems

recipe.name: Paneer Cafreal

ingredients.name: fresh coriander leaves and tender stems

steps: Blend coriander, chilies, ginger, garlic, lime juice, vinegar, cumin, pepper, cinnamon and salt into a thick green cafreal paste.
Coat large paneer cubes evenly with the paste and refrigerate 15 minutes. Reserve any paste left in the bowl.
Heat oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Sear the marinated paneer in one layer for 2–3 minutes per side until lightly charred; turn gently.
Lower the heat, add reserved green paste with a splash of water if necessary, and cook 3 minutes until it clings to the paneer and no raw aroma remains.
Rest 2 minutes, then serve the bright green, mostly dry cafreal with lime wedges and Goan poi or rice.
tips: Cafreal is a seared green-masala dish, not a thin curry; use only enough liquid to coat paneer.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Paneer Malaikari
steps: Pat paneer dry. Heat mustard oil until shimmering, lower heat, and briefly sear paneer cubes for 1 minute per side. Remove so they stay tender.
In the same oil, fry cardamom and cinnamon for 30 seconds. Add onion and cook 6 minutes until soft and pale golden; add ginger paste and cook 1 minute.
Stir in turmeric, chili powder and salt. Add water and simmer 3 minutes to cook the spices and loosen the onion base.
Pour in unsweetened coconut milk and slit chilies. Simmer gently for 5–6 minutes without boiling hard, until the pale golden sauce coats a spoon.
Return paneer and warm through for 3 minutes. Rest covered 5 minutes and serve the coconut-scented malaikari with steamed rice.
tips: Use unsweetened coconut milk and a gentle simmer so the sauce stays silky instead of separating.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Veg Do Pyaza

ingredients.name: onions, half finely chopped and half in petals

steps: Blanch cauliflower and peas in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain. Keep the onion petals separate from the finely chopped onion.
Heat 15 ml oil in a pan and stir-fry onion petals and capsicum for 3 minutes until lightly browned but still crisp; remove to a plate.
Heat remaining oil, sizzle cumin and cook chopped onion for 7–8 minutes until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, coriander and chili; fry 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, salt and water. Simmer 8 minutes until the gravy thickens, then add cauliflower and peas and cook 5 minutes.
Fold in the reserved onion petals and capsicum with garam masala. Cook just 1 minute and serve, leaving the second batch of onions clearly visible.
tips: Do pyaza gets its character from onions cooked twice to two textures; do not simmer the onion petals until soft.

gu.Fold in the reserved onion petals and ca: અલગ રાખેલી ડુંગળીની પાંખડીઓ અને શિમલા મરચું ગરમ મસાલા સાથે ભેળવો. માત્ર 1 મિનિટ રાંધી પીરસો જેથી બીજી હપ્તાની ડુંગળી દેખાય.
gu.Do pyaza gets its character from onions: દો પ્યાઝાની ઓળખ બે રીતે રાંધેલી ડુંગળી છે; પાંખડીઓ બહુ નરમ થાય ત્યાં સુધી ન ઉકાળો.

recipe.name: Veg Kheema
steps: Pulse cauliflower and carrot briefly to a coarse mince; do not puree. Keep peas whole for colour and bite.
Heat oil and cumin in a wide pan. Fry onion for 7–8 minutes until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste and green chili for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander powder and 5 g salt. Cook uncovered for 8 minutes, pressing tomatoes until the masala is thick and nearly dry.
Add minced cauliflower, carrot and peas. Cook uncovered for 8–10 minutes, stirring, until vegetables are tender and excess moisture evaporates.
Finish with remaining salt, garam masala and coriander leaves. Serve the semi-dry vegetable keema with pav or roti.
tips: A coarse mince gives the right texture; finely pureed vegetables release too much water.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

बारीक फूलगोभी, गाजर और मटर डालें। 8–10 मिनट बिना ढके चलाते हुए पकाएँ, जब तक सब्जियाँ नरम और अतिरिक्त पानी सूख जाए।

gu.Finish with remaining salt, garam masala: બાકી મીઠું, ગરમ મસાલો અને કોથમીર ભેળવો. અર્ધસૂકો શાકનો કીમો પાવ કે રોટલી સાથે પીરસો.

dish.name: Kathal Kofta
ingredients: young green jackfruit, drained and chopped

recipe.name: Kathal Kofta

ingredients.name: young green jackfruit, drained and chopped

steps: Boil the young jackfruit until tender, about 15 minutes, then drain very well and shred finely. Squeeze out excess moisture so kofta will hold together.
Mix jackfruit with mashed potato, chickpea flour, 4 g salt and half the garam masala. Shape into 12 firm balls; rest 10 minutes.
Heat 55 ml oil in a pan and shallow-fry kofta in batches until golden on all sides, about 7 minutes per batch. Drain on kitchen paper.
Heat remaining oil, fry onion 7 minutes, then ginger-garlic paste 1 minute. Add tomato puree, coriander, chili and remaining salt; cook 10 minutes until thick. Add water and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in remaining garam masala. Place kofta in a serving dish and spoon hot gravy around them just before eating so the crust stays intact.
tips: Drain jackfruit thoroughly; wet shreds make fragile kofta that break during frying.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।

hi.Mix jackfruit with mashed potato, chickp: कटहल में मसला आलू, बेसन, 4 ग्राम नमक और आधा गरम मसाला मिलाएँ। 12 कसे गोले बनाएँ और 10 मिनट रहने दें।
hi.Heat 55 ml oil in a pan and shallow-fry: पैन में 55 मिली तेल गरम करके कोफ्ते बैच में हर तरफ सुनहरे होने तक लगभग 7 मिनट सेंकें। कागज़ पर निकालें।

hi.Drain jackfruit thoroughly; wet shreds m: कटहल खूब निथारें; गीले रेशों से कोफ्ते तलते समय टूट सकते हैं।

recipe.name: Kaddu Kofta
steps: Sprinkle grated pumpkin with 3 g salt and leave 10 minutes. Squeeze dry, saving about 100 ml of the released juice to use in the gravy.
Mix squeezed pumpkin with chickpea flour and 2 g salt. Shape into 12 small balls; if soft, rest 5 minutes so flour absorbs moisture.
Shallow-fry the balls in 55 ml hot oil in batches, turning gently until golden and cooked through, about 6–7 minutes. Drain.

In remaining oil, fry onion 7 minutes and ginger-garlic paste 1 minute. Add tomato puree, coriander, chili and remaining salt; cook 9 minutes. Add water and reserved pumpkin juice and simmer 5 minutes.
Finish gravy with garam masala. Arrange pumpkin kofta in a bowl and pour hot gravy around them at serving time; serve with roti.
tips: Squeeze grated pumpkin before mixing the kofta; otherwise the batter needs too much flour and turns dense.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Mix squeezed pumpkin with chickpea flour: निचोड़े कद्दू में बेसन और 2 ग्राम नमक मिलाएँ। 12 छोटे गोले बनाएँ; नरम हों तो 5 मिनट रखें ताकि बेसन नमी सोखे।

recipe.name: Mochar Kofta
steps: Separate banana-blossom florets and remove the tough stigma and clear sheath from each. Chop finely, rinse, and boil with a pinch of turmeric for 15 minutes; drain and squeeze dry.
Mix cooked blossom with mashed potato, chickpea flour, 4 g salt and half the garam masala. Form 12 oval kofta and let stand 10 minutes.
Heat 50 ml mustard oil until shimmering, lower heat and shallow-fry kofta in batches until browned on all sides. Drain without breaking them.

dish.name: Achari Soya Chaap
ingredients: plain soya chaap, drained and sliced

recipe.name: Achari Soya Chaap

ingredients.name: plain soya chaap, drained and sliced

steps: Drain packaged soya chaap, rinse briefly and pat dry. Cut into thick diagonal pieces so the achari marinade can coat each surface.
Crush fennel, mustard, fenugreek and nigella coarsely. Whisk with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chili, lemon juice and 6 g salt; coat chaap and marinate 20 minutes.
Heat mustard oil until shimmering and lower the heat. Sauté onions for 5 minutes until lightly golden.
Add the marinated chaap and all yogurt mixture. Cook over medium heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until the yogurt thickens and clings to the pieces.
Add remaining salt to taste and cook 2 more minutes until the masala is glossy and mostly dry. Serve hot with roti and sliced onions.
tips: Crush the pickle spices only coarsely for the characteristic achari aroma; do not use sweet pickle syrup.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

dish.name: Soya Chaap Tikka Masala
ingredients: plain soya chaap, drained and cut

recipe.name: Soya Chaap Tikka Masala

ingredients.name: plain soya chaap, drained and cut

steps: Pat chaap dry. Mix yogurt with half the ginger-garlic paste, half the chili, half the garam masala and 4 g salt; coat chaap and marinate 20 minutes.
Heat 20 ml oil in a grill pan. Sear chaap over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until charred in spots and cooked through; set aside.
In another pan heat remaining oil. Fry onion 8 minutes until golden, then add remaining ginger-garlic paste, chili, coriander and tomato puree. Cook 10 minutes until thick.
Add water and remaining salt; simmer 5 minutes. Stir in cream and remaining garam masala, keeping the gravy at a gentle heat.
Add grilled chaap to the sauce and simmer 3 minutes so the smoky pieces absorb the tikka masala. Serve with naan or rice.
tips: Sear marinated chaap before adding it to the gravy; this separates tikka masala from a plain chaap curry.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Tofu Makhani
steps: Press tofu for 15 minutes, cut into even cubes and pat dry. Soak cashews in 100 ml hot water for 15 minutes, then blend smooth with the soaking liquid.
Melt half the butter in a pan. Lightly sear tofu for 2 minutes per side, just enough to colour the edges; remove.
In the same pan melt remaining butter and fry ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute. Add tomato puree, chili and salt; cook 10–12 minutes until thick and the raw tomato aroma disappears.
Stir in cashew paste and remaining water. Simmer gently for 5 minutes. Add tofu and cook 3 minutes so the sauce coats the cubes.
Switch off heat and stir in cream, garam masala and crushed kasuri methi. Rest 3 minutes and serve with roti or rice.
tips: Pressing tofu keeps the cubes firm in the silky makhani sauce; add cream only after turning off heat.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Pressing tofu keeps the cubes firm in th: ટોફુ દબાવવાથી મખની ગ્રેવીમાં ટુકડા ટકે છે; ક્રીમ તાપ બંધ કર્યા પછી નાખો.

recipe.name: Palak Tofu
steps: Blanch washed spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, then plunge into cold water and drain. Blend with green chili and 60 ml water to a smooth green puree.
Press and cube tofu; pat dry. Heat 15 ml oil and sear tofu for 2 minutes per side until light gold; remove.
Heat remaining oil and sizzle cumin. Fry onion for 7 minutes, add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute, then tomato and 5 g salt; cook 6 minutes until soft.
Add spinach puree and remaining water. Simmer uncovered for 4–5 minutes, stirring, but avoid a long boil so the green remains bright.
Fold in tofu, garam masala and remaining salt. Warm gently for 3 minutes and serve with roti.
tips: Cool blanched spinach promptly to preserve its green colour; add tofu near the end.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Chilli Tofu
steps: Press tofu for 15 minutes, cut into cubes and pat dry. Toss with 30 g cornstarch and salt until lightly coated.
Heat 35 ml oil in a wide pan. Pan-fry tofu in one layer for 3 minutes per side until crisp and golden; transfer to a plate.
Heat remaining oil and stir-fry garlic, ginger and green chilies for 30 seconds. Add onion petals and capsicum; toss over high heat for 3 minutes, keeping them crisp.
Mix soy sauce, chili sauce, vinegar, water and remaining 10 g cornstarch. Pour into the pan and cook 1–2 minutes, stirring until glossy and lightly thickened.
Return tofu and toss quickly so every cube is coated. Finish with spring onions and serve immediately before the tofu loses its crisp edges.
tips: Use a vegetarian chili sauce and press tofu well; a hot pan gives crisp cubes without deep-frying.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mushroom Kurma
steps: Blend coconut, cashews, fennel, green chili and 120 ml water into a smooth kurma paste. Wipe mushrooms clean and quarter them.
Heat coconut oil and fry curry leaves briefly. Add onions and sauté 7 minutes until lightly golden; add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, turmeric and salt. Cook 6 minutes, pressing the tomatoes until soft and thick.
Add mushrooms and stir-fry 5 minutes until they release moisture. Stir in the coconut-cashew paste and remaining water, then simmer gently 8 minutes until mushrooms are tender.
Taste for salt and rest 3 minutes before serving with chapati, appam or rice.
tips: Do not soak mushrooms in water; wipe them clean so the kurma stays rich instead of watery.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kathal Korma

ingredients.name: young green jackfruit, drained and cubed

steps: Boil young jackfruit 12–15 minutes until just tender, then drain and pat dry. Soak cashews in 100 ml hot water and blend smooth.
Heat ghee and fry sliced onions 10 minutes until deep golden. Remove one-third for garnish; add cardamom, cinnamon and ginger-garlic paste to the rest, and cook 1 minute.
Add jackfruit and ground coriander, toss for 3 minutes so the edges take colour. Lower the heat.
Whisk yogurt with cashew paste and 60 ml water. Add it gradually, stirring constantly so it does not split. Add remaining water and salt; cover and simmer 12 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and reserved golden onions. Rest 5 minutes and serve the creamy korma with naan or rice.
tips: Use unripe jackfruit; ripe sweet jackfruit will not give the savoury korma texture.

recipe.name: Kanguch Yakhni
steps: Rinse dried morels carefully to remove grit. Soak in 350 ml warm water for 20 minutes, then lift out, split and rinse interiors; strain the soaking liquid through a fine sieve and reserve.
Whisk room-temperature yogurt with chickpea flour, dried ginger and fennel powder until smooth. Gradually whisk in 150 ml water.
Heat ghee and bloom cardamom, cinnamon and cloves for 30 seconds. Add cleaned morels and sauté 3 minutes.
Lower the heat. Pour in yogurt mixture slowly while stirring without pause; add the strained soaking liquid and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, not a hard boil.
Cook uncovered on low for 12–15 minutes, stirring often, until morels are tender and the pale yakhni lightly coats a spoon. Serve with steamed rice.
tips: Morels trap grit inside their honeycomb; rinse the split interiors and strain the soaking liquor before use.

dish.name: Kachri ki Sabzi
ingredients: fresh kachri wild melons, peeled and sliced

recipe.name: Kachri ki Sabzi

ingredients.name: fresh kachri wild melons, peeled and sliced

steps: Peel and slice the fresh kachri. Touch a tiny raw sliver of each melon to the tongue, then spit it out; discard any bitter fruit and use only pleasantly sour kachri.
Heat oil and sizzle cumin and mustard seeds. Add green chilies and kachri slices; sauté for 5 minutes.
Add turmeric, chili, coriander and salt. Cook uncovered 6–8 minutes, stirring, until the kachri softens and most moisture evaporates.
Reduce heat and continue stir-frying for 4 minutes, scraping the pan, until the spices cling to the kachri and the sabzi is nearly dry.
Check that the kachri is tender, not watery. Serve the slightly sour, spicy dry sabzi hot with bajra roti or phulka.
tips: Never use bitter kachri; touch a tiny piece to the tongue and spit it out when checking each fruit.

dish.name: Kaju Gathiya nu Shaak
ingredients: plain Gujarati gathiya, broken into short pieces

recipe.name: Kaju Gathiya nu Shaak

ingredients.name: plain Gujarati gathiya, broken into short pieces

steps: Toast cashews in a dry pan for 3 minutes until lightly golden; set aside. Break gathiya into short pieces but do not crush to powder.
Heat oil and crackle mustard and cumin. Add onion, garlic and green chili; sauté 5–6 minutes until the onion softens.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, chili, jaggery and salt. Cook 8 minutes, pressing the tomatoes until the masala becomes pulpy and glossy.
Add water and simmer 5 minutes to make a thick, tangy Kathiyawadi gravy. Stir in toasted cashews.
Turn off heat. Fold in gathiya only just before serving so some pieces soften while others retain bite. Garnish with coriander and serve with rotla.
tips: Gathiya absorbs gravy fast; add it at the table rather than simmering it for a long time.

dish.name: Kaju Karela
ingredients: bitter gourd, deseeded and thinly sliced

recipe.name: Kaju Karela

ingredients.name: bitter gourd, deseeded and thinly sliced

steps: Halve the bitter gourds lengthwise, scoop out mature seeds and slice thinly. Toss with 5 g salt and rest for 15 minutes, then squeeze firmly and pat dry; this moderates bitterness without removing its characteristic flavour.
Heat 15 ml oil in a wide pan. Fry the cashews over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes until evenly golden, lifting them out before they darken.

Add remaining oil to the pan. Let mustard seeds crackle, then add onion and cook 5–6 minutes until golden. Add sliced karela and turmeric; spread in one layer and cook uncovered for 12–15 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender and browned at the edges.

Stir in remaining 4 g salt, chilli and coriander-cumin powder. Cook 3 minutes so the spices cling to the karela. Mix in jaggery and lemon juice and cook 2 minutes more for a balanced sweet-sour finish.
Fold in the fried cashews only at the end so they stay crisp. Serve hot with roti or dal-rice; the finished shaak should be fairly dry rather than swimming in gravy.
tips: Dry the squeezed karela before frying so it browns instead of steaming; add cashews after cooking to preserve crunch.

recipe.name: Phulkopir Roast
steps: Cut cauliflower into large even florets and potatoes into 2 cm cubes. Dry the cauliflower thoroughly, then toss both vegetables with 2 g turmeric and 3 g salt.

Heat 35 ml mustard oil until shimmering, then lower to medium heat. Shallow-fry cauliflower in batches until golden at the edges, about 6 minutes per batch; lift out. Fry potatoes until lightly browned and remove.
Add the remaining oil and soften onion for 7–8 minutes. Stir in ginger, tomato, cumin, coriander, chilli and remaining turmeric; cook until the tomato collapses and oil begins to separate.

Lower the heat and whisk yogurt into the masala a spoonful at a time to prevent splitting. Add 120 ml water and remaining 7 g salt, return the fried potato and cauliflower, cover and simmer 10–12 minutes until potato is tender and sauce is thick.
Uncover and cook 3–4 minutes more, gently turning the cauliflower to coat each floret without breaking it. Sprinkle garam masala, rest 5 minutes, and serve with luchi or rice.
tips: Keep the cauliflower florets large and pre-fry them; this preserves their shape in the rich Bengali masala.

gu.Cut cauliflower into large even florets: ફૂલકોબીને મોટા સરખા ફૂલમાં અને બટાકાને 2 સેમી ટુકડામાં કાપો. ફૂલકોબી સારી રીતે સૂકવી બંને શાકમાં 2 ગ્રામ હળદર અને 3 ગ્રામ મીઠું ભેળવો.

gu.Lower the heat and whisk yogurt into the: તાપ ધીમો કરી દહીં એક-એક ચમચી ફેંટીને મસાલામાં ભેળવો જેથી ફાટે નહીં. 120 મિલી પાણી અને બાકીનું 7 ગ્રામ મીઠું નાખો, તળેલા બટાકા અને ફૂલકોબી પાછાં નાખી ઢાંકી 10–12 મિનિટ બટાકા નરમ અને રસો ઘાટો થાય ત્યાં સુધી પકાવો.

recipe.name: Palda
steps: Cube peeled potatoes into even 2–3 cm pieces. Simmer in lightly salted water for 8–10 minutes until almost tender, then drain; they will finish cooking in the yogurt gravy.
Whisk room-temperature yogurt with rice flour, turmeric and 320 ml water until completely smooth. The rice flour stabilizes the yogurt and lightly thickens the sauce.
Warm ghee in a heavy pan over medium heat. Sizzle cumin, fennel, crushed cardamom, cloves and dried red chilli for 30 seconds without burning them.
Add potatoes and toss in the scented ghee for 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low and slowly pour in the yogurt mixture, stirring continuously until it begins to steam; do not let it boil hard.

Add 9 g salt and simmer gently for 10–12 minutes, stirring often, until the potatoes are soft and the gravy coats a spoon. Rest for 5 minutes, remove the whole cloves if desired, and serve with steamed rice.
tips: Use room-temperature yogurt and gentle heat throughout; a rapid boil can split this Himachali yogurt gravy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.plain yogurt, at room temperature: सादा दही, कमरे के तापमान पर
hi.Cube peeled potatoes into even 2–3 cm pi: छिले आलू समान 2–3 सेमी टुकड़ों में काटें। हल्के नमकीन पानी में 8–10 मिनट लगभग नरम होने तक उबालें और छानें; वे दही की ग्रेवी में पूरी तरह पकेंगे।
hi.Whisk room-temperature yogurt with rice: कमरे के तापमान वाले दही में चावल का आटा, हल्दी और 320 मिली पानी डालकर एकदम चिकना फेंटें। चावल का आटा दही को फटने से बचाता और ग्रेवी को हल्का गाढ़ा करता है।
hi.Warm ghee in a heavy pan over medium hea: भारी पैन में मध्यम आँच पर घी गरम करें। जीरा, सौंफ, कुचली इलायची, लौंग और सूखी लाल मिर्च 30 सेकंड बिना जलाए चटकाएँ।
hi.Add potatoes and toss in the scented ghe: आलू डालकर सुगंधित घी में 2 मिनट पलटें। आँच धीमी करें और लगातार चलाते हुए दही का मिश्रण धीरे-धीरे डालें; भाप निकलने तक गरम करें पर तेज़ उबाल न आने दें।
hi.Add 9 g salt and simmer gently for 10–12: 9 ग्राम नमक डालकर बार-बार चलाते हुए 10–12 मिनट हल्का उबालें, ताकि आलू नरम हों और ग्रेवी चम्मच पर चढ़े। 5 मिनट रखें, चाहें तो साबुत लौंग निकालें और चावल के साथ परोसें।
hi.Use room-temperature yogurt and gentle h: दही कमरे के तापमान पर रखें और पूरे समय धीमी आँच इस्तेमाल करें; तेज़ उबाल से यह हिमाचली दही की ग्रेवी फट सकती है।

gu.Warm ghee in a heavy pan over medium hea: જાડા પૅનમાં મધ્યમ તાપે ઘી ગરમ કરો. જીરું, વરિયાળી, વાટેલી એલચી, લવિંગ અને સૂકું લાલ મરચું બળે નહીં તેમ 30 સેકંડ તતડાવો.
gu.Add potatoes and toss in the scented ghe: બટાકા નાખી સુગંધી ઘીમાં 2 મિનિટ ફેરવો. તાપ ધીમો કરી સતત હલાવતા દહીંનું મિશ્રણ ધીમે-ધીમે રેડો; વરાળ નીકળે ત્યાં સુધી ગરમ કરો પણ ખૂબ ઉકાળશો નહીં.

dish.name: Vendakkai Mandi
ingredients: okra, dried and cut into 4 cm pieces

recipe.name: Vendakkai Mandi

ingredients.name: okra, dried and cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Rinse uncooked rice in clean water and reserve 450 ml of the cloudy second wash. Soak tamarind pulp in 120 ml warm water for 10 minutes, squeeze and strain to make tangy tamarind water.

Wash okra and dry it completely before cutting into 4 cm pieces; moisture on the pods makes them slimy. Heat 25 ml sesame oil and sauté okra over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes until the cut edges are lightly seared. Remove.

Heat remaining oil in the same pan. Crackle mustard seeds, add curry leaves and shallots, and sauté 5 minutes until the shallots soften. Add tomato, turmeric and chilli powder; cook until the tomato breaks down.
Pour in tamarind water and simmer 5 minutes to remove its raw taste. Add the reserved rice-washing water and salt, bring to a gentle simmer, then return the okra.
Cook uncovered for 8–10 minutes until the okra is tender and the rice-water gravy is slightly thickened but still spoonable. Rest 5 minutes and serve with steamed rice; avoid over-stirring the okra.
tips: Mandi means the cloudy water from washing rice; it gives this Chettinad tamarind-okra curry its characteristic light body.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Rinse uncooked rice in clean water and r: कच्चे चावल साफ़ पानी में धोकर दूसरे धोवन का 450 मिली मटमैला पानी बचाएँ। इमली के गूदे को 120 मिली गुनगुने पानी में 10 मिनट भिगोएँ, मसलें और छानकर खट्टा इमली पानी बनाएँ।
hi.Wash okra and dry it completely before c: भिंडी धोकर 4 सेमी काटने से पहले पूरी तरह सुखाएँ; गीली भिंडी लसलसी हो जाती है। 25 मिली तिल के तेल में भिंडी मध्यम-तेज़ आँच पर 6–8 मिनट कटे किनारे हल्के सिकने तक भूनकर निकालें।
hi.Heat remaining oil in the same pan. Crac: उसी पैन में बचा तेल गरम करें। राई चटकाएँ, करी पत्ते और छोटे प्याज़ डालकर 5 मिनट नरम करें। टमाटर, हल्दी और मिर्च डालें; टमाटर गलने तक पकाएँ।
hi.Pour in tamarind water and simmer 5 minu: इमली पानी डालकर 5 मिनट उबालें ताकि कच्चापन दूर हो। बचा चावल धोवन और नमक डालकर हल्का उबाल लाएँ, फिर भिंडी वापस डालें।
hi.Cook uncovered for 8–10 minutes until th: बिना ढके 8–10 मिनट भिंडी नरम और चावल-पानी की ग्रेवी हल्की गाढ़ी पर तरल रहने तक पकाएँ। 5 मिनट रखकर चावल के साथ परोसें; भिंडी को ज़्यादा न चलाएँ।
hi.Mandi means the cloudy water from washin: मंडी चावल धोने के मटमैले पानी को कहते हैं; इसी से चेट्टिनाड की इमली-भिंडी करी में खास हल्का गाढ़ापन आता है।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.Rinse uncooked rice in clean water and r: કાચા ચોખા સ્વચ્છ પાણીમાં ધોઈ બીજા ધોવાણનું 450 મિલી ડહોળું પાણી સાચવો. આમલીનો ગર 120 મિલી હૂંફાળા પાણીમાં 10 મિનિટ પલાળો, મસળી ગાળી ખાટું આમલીનું પાણી બનાવો.
gu.Wash okra and dry it completely before c: ભીંડા ધોઈ 4 સેમી કાપતાં પહેલાં સાવ સૂકવો; ભીના ભીંડા ચીકણા થાય છે. 25 મિલી તલના તેલમાં ભીંડા મધ્યમથી ઊંચા તાપે 6–8 મિનિટ કાપેલી કિનારી સહેજ શેકાય ત્યાં સુધી સાંતળી કાઢો.
gu.Heat remaining oil in the same pan. Crac: એ જ પૅનમાં બાકીનું તેલ ગરમ કરો. રાઈ તતડાવી મીઠા લીમડાના પાન અને નાની ડુંગળી નાખી 5 મિનિટ નરમ કરો. ટામેટાં, હળદર અને મરચું નાખી ટામેટાં ગળે ત્યાં સુધી પકાવો.
gu.Pour in tamarind water and simmer 5 minu: આમલીનું પાણી નાખી કાચો સ્વાદ જાય ત્યાં સુધી 5 મિનિટ ઉકાળો. સાચવેલું ચોખાનું ધોવાણ અને મીઠું નાખી હળવો ઉકળાટ લાવો, પછી ભીંડા પાછા નાખો.
gu.Cook uncovered for 8–10 minutes until th: ઢાંક્યા વગર 8–10 મિનિટ ભીંડા નરમ અને ચોખા-પાણીનો રસો થોડો ઘાટો છતાં રેડી શકાય તેવો થાય ત્યાં સુધી પકાવો. 5 મિનિટ રાખી ભાત સાથે પીરસો; ભીંડા વધારે હલાવશો નહીં.
gu.Mandi means the cloudy water from washin: માંડી એટલે ચોખા ધોવાનું ડહોળું પાણી; તે ચેટ્ટિનાડની આમલી-ભીંડાની કઢીને ખાસ હળવું ઘટ્ટપણું આપે છે.

dish.name: Chakka Kuru Manga Curry
ingredients: raw green mango, peeled and chopped

recipe.name: Chakka Kuru Manga Curry

ingredients.name: raw green mango, peeled and chopped

steps: Peel the papery outer skin from the jackfruit seeds and remove any hard brown coating. Halve large seeds, cover with 450 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes until nearly tender.
Add raw mango, turmeric and salt to the jackfruit seeds. Simmer for 7 minutes more, until the mango softens but keeps some shape.
Grind grated coconut, cumin and green chilies with 150 ml water to a smooth paste. Stir the paste into the pot and simmer gently for 4 minutes; do not boil hard after adding coconut.
Heat coconut oil in a small pan. Let mustard seeds crackle, then add dried red chilies and curry leaves for 30 seconds. Pour this tempering over the curry.
Cover and rest for 5 minutes so the coconut and tempering mingle. Serve warm with steamed rice; taste first and add a little more salt only if the mango needs it.
tips: Jackfruit seeds must be fully cooked before eating. The tartness of raw mango varies; start with the stated amount and adjust at the end.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kerala Mushroom Roast
steps: Clean mushrooms with a damp cloth and halve large ones. Keep them dry so they brown instead of steaming.
Heat 20 ml coconut oil in a wide pan. Cook onions with half the curry leaves for 10 minutes until deep golden. Add ginger, garlic and slit green chilies; stir for 1 minute.
Add coriander, chili powder, turmeric, pepper and crushed fennel. Stir for 30 seconds, then add chopped tomatoes and salt. Cook for 6 minutes until the tomato moisture reduces to a thick masala.
Add mushrooms and spread them across the pan. Cook uncovered over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring only occasionally, until the water they release evaporates and their edges brown.
Add the remaining 10 ml coconut oil and curry leaves. Roast for 2 minutes more until the masala clings to the mushrooms; serve semi-dry with appam or chapati.
tips: Use a wide pan and avoid crowding it: mushrooms release water, and a Kerala roast should finish with concentrated masala rather than thin gravy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kerala Soya Roast
steps: Boil soy chunks in 1 litre of the water for 7 minutes. Drain, rinse with the remaining 500 ml fresh water and squeeze firmly twice; this removes the packaged soy smell and helps the masala cling.

Heat 20 ml coconut oil in a wide heavy pan. Toast coconut slivers until golden, then lift out. Add fennel seeds, sliced shallots and half the curry leaves; cook for 9 minutes until the shallots brown.
Add ginger, garlic and slit green chilies for 1 minute. Stir in coriander, chili powder, turmeric, pepper and salt with a splash of water; cook for 2 minutes until fragrant without scorching.
Add squeezed soy chunks and stir to coat every piece. Cook uncovered for 8 minutes over medium heat, turning occasionally, so the masala dries and darkens on the edges.
Add remaining 15 ml coconut oil, toasted coconut slivers and curry leaves. Roast for 3 minutes until the chunks are browned and nearly dry. Serve with Kerala parotta or rice.
tips: Squeezing the boiled soy chunks is essential for a pleasant texture. Finish uncovered; adding a lot of water turns this roast into a curry.

gu.Add ginger, garlic and slit green chilie: આદુ, લસણ અને ચીરેલાં લીલાં મરચાં નાખી 1 મિનિટ હલાવો. ધાણો, મરચું પાઉડર, હળદર, કાળો મરી અને મીઠું થોડા પાણી સાથે નાખી બળે નહીં એમ 2 મિનિટ સુગંધ આવે ત્યાં સુધી રાંધો.
gu.Add squeezed soy chunks and stir to coat: નિચોવેલા સોયા ચંક્સ નાખી દરેક ટુકડાને મસાલો ચોપડો. મધ્યમ તાપે 8 મિનિટ ઢાંક્યા વગર ક્યારેક પલટો જેથી મસાલો સૂકાય અને કિનારા ઘેરા થાય.
gu.Add remaining 15 ml coconut oil, toasted: બાકીનું 15 મિલી નાળિયેરનું તેલ, શેકેલી નાળિયેરની કાતરી અને મીઠા લીમડાનાં પાન નાખો. ચંક્સ ભૂખરા અને લગભગ સૂકા થાય ત્યાં સુધી 3 મિનિટ શેકો. કેરળ પરોટ્ટા કે ભાત સાથે પીરસો.

dish.name: Ambe Sasam

recipe.name: Ambe Sasam

ingredients.name: firm ripe mango flesh, cut into chunks

steps: Choose mangoes that are ripe and sweet but still firm enough to cut. Peel, cut the flesh into generous chunks, and collect any juice in the serving bowl.

Dry-toast 6 g of the dried red chilies for 1 minute. Grind them with coconut, 5 g mustard seeds and 120 ml water to a smooth, thick paste; stop as soon as it is smooth so the mustard stays pleasantly sharp rather than bitter.

Fold the coconut-mustard paste, jaggery and salt through the mango chunks. Add the remaining 60 ml water a little at a time to make a coating sauce, not a thin soup. Taste and balance sweetness against mustard heat.
Warm coconut oil in a small pan. Crackle the remaining 3 g mustard seeds, then fry the remaining 2 g dried chili and curry leaves for 20 seconds. Pour over the mango mixture.
Rest covered for 10 minutes, then serve at room temperature alongside rice and a mild dal. Do not simmer the ripe mango; its fresh texture is part of this Konkani dish.
tips: Use sweet, fragrant ripe mango, not sour green mango. If mangoes are very sweet, reduce jaggery after tasting; grind mustard briefly to avoid bitterness.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।

hi.Choose mangoes that are ripe and sweet b: ऐसे आम चुनें जो मीठे और पके हों, फिर भी काटने लायक सख़्त हों। छीलकर गूदे के बड़े टुकड़े करें और निकला रस परोसने वाले कटोरे में रखें।
hi.Dry-toast 6 g of the dried red chilies f: 6 ग्राम सूखी लाल मिर्च को 1 मिनट बिना तेल भूनें। इसे नारियल, 5 ग्राम राई और 120 मिली पानी के साथ गाढ़ा चिकना पीसें; चिकना होते ही रोकें ताकि राई कड़वी न हो।
hi.Fold the coconut-mustard paste, jaggery: नारियल-राई का पेस्ट, गुड़ और नमक आम के टुकड़ों में हल्के हाथ से मिलाएँ। बचा 60 मिली पानी थोड़ा-थोड़ा डालें ताकि पतली तरी नहीं, आम पर लिपटने वाली चटनी बने। चखकर मिठास और राई का तीखापन संतुलित करें।
hi.Warm coconut oil in a small pan. Crackle: छोटे पैन में नारियल तेल गरम करें। बची 3 ग्राम राई चटकाएँ, फिर बची 2 ग्राम सूखी मिर्च और करी पत्ते 20 सेकंड भूनें। तड़का आम पर डालें।
hi.Rest covered for 10 minutes, then serve: ढककर 10 मिनट रखें, फिर चावल और हल्की दाल के साथ कमरे के तापमान पर परोसें। पके आम को न उबालें; उसकी ताज़ी बनावट इस कोंकणी व्यंजन की पहचान है।
hi.Use sweet, fragrant ripe mango, not sour: मीठे, सुगंधित पके आम लें, खट्टे कच्चे आम नहीं। आम बहुत मीठे हों तो चखकर गुड़ घटाएँ; राई को ज़्यादा न पीसें, वरना कड़वाहट आएगी।

gu.firm ripe mango flesh, cut into chunks: પાકેલી પણ કઠણ કેરીના મોટા ટુકડા
gu.Choose mangoes that are ripe and sweet b: મીઠી અને પાકેલી, છતાં કાપી શકાય એટલી કઠણ કેરી પસંદ કરો. છોલીને ગરનાં મોટા ટુકડા કરો અને નીકળેલો રસ પીરસવાના વાટકામાં ભેગો કરો.
gu.Dry-toast 6 g of the dried red chilies f: 6 ગ્રામ સૂકાં લાલ મરચાંને 1 મિનિટ તેલ વગર શેકો. તેને નાળિયેર, 5 ગ્રામ રાઈ અને 120 મિલી પાણી સાથે જાડી સુંવાળી પેસ્ટ વાટો; સુંવાળી થાય કે તરત રોકો જેથી રાઈ કડવી ન બને.
gu.Fold the coconut-mustard paste, jaggery: નાળિયેર-રાઈની પેસ્ટ, ગોળ અને મીઠું કેરીમાં હળવા હાથે ભેળવો. બચેલું 60 મિલી પાણી થોડું-થોડું નાખો જેથી પાતળી રસાવાળી કરી નહીં, કેરીને ચોંટે એવી ચટણી બને. ચાખીને મીઠાશ અને રાઈની તીખાશ સંતુલિત કરો.
gu.Warm coconut oil in a small pan. Crackle: નાના પૅનમાં નાળિયેરનું તેલ ગરમ કરો. બચેલી 3 ગ્રામ રાઈ તતડાવો, પછી બચેલાં 2 ગ્રામ સૂકાં મરચાં અને મીઠા લીમડાનાં પાન 20 સેકન્ડ સાંતળો. વઘાર કેરી પર રેડો.
gu.Rest covered for 10 minutes, then serve: ઢાંકીને 10 મિનિટ રાખો, પછી ભાત અને હળવી દાળ સાથે સામાન્ય તાપમાને પીરસો. પાકેલી કેરી ઉકાળશો નહીં; તેની તાજી બનાવટ આ કોંકણી વાનગીની ઓળખ છે.
gu.Use sweet, fragrant ripe mango, not sour: મીઠી, સુગંધિત પાકેલી કેરી લો, ખાટી કાચી કેરી નહીં. કેરી બહુ મીઠી હોય તો ચાખીને ગોળ ઘટાડો; રાઈ વધુ ન વાટો, નહીં તો કડવાશ આવશે.

recipe.name: Kumm Curry
steps: Grind coconut, cumin and garlic with 100 ml water to a smooth paste. Wipe mushrooms clean and slice thickly so they stay substantial in the gravy.
Heat oil in a wide pan. Fry curry leaves, dried red chilies and crushed peppercorns for 30 seconds, then add onions and green chilies. Cook for 7 minutes until the onions turn golden.
Add mushrooms and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring until they release moisture and shrink. Do not add extra water at this stage.
Stir in the coconut paste, chopped tomatoes, crushed coriander, turmeric and salt. Cook for 5 minutes until the raw coconut aroma fades and the tomatoes soften.
Add the remaining 100 ml water and simmer for 6 minutes until the peppery coconut gravy coats the mushrooms. Taste, adjust salt and serve with rice or parotta.
tips: This Kodava curry is peppery and coconut-rich; keep the mushrooms thickly cut so they do not disappear in the sauce.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Kinema Curry
steps: Use purchased, properly fermented kinema that is ready to cook; do not attempt a homemade room-temperature fermentation from this curry recipe. Break apart any large sticky clumps with a spoon.
Heat mustard oil until it just begins to smoke, then lower the heat. Add cumin seeds for 20 seconds, followed by onion; cook for 6 minutes until golden.
Stir in ginger, garlic and green chilies for 1 minute. Add turmeric and chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until the tomatoes collapse into a thick base.
Add kinema and stir-fry for 3 minutes so the fermented soybeans take on the masala. Pour in 300 ml water and add salt.
Simmer uncovered for 8 minutes until the curry is spoonable and the soybeans are heated thoroughly. Sprinkle coriander over the top and serve hot with plain rice.
tips: Kinema has a strong fermented aroma; that is characteristic, but discard it if it smells rotten or shows unfamiliar mold. Buy from a reputable source and keep refrigerated as directed.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Malaysian Vegetable Curry
steps: Cut the vegetables into bite-sized pieces of similar thickness. Check the curry powder label to ensure it is vegetarian; bruise the lemongrass with the back of a knife.
Heat oil in a deep pan. Cook onion for 5 minutes, then add ginger and lemongrass for 1 minute. Stir in curry powder and turmeric with a splash of water and fry 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add potatoes, carrots and 300 ml water. Cover and simmer 10 minutes so the firm vegetables start to soften before the quicker-cooking ones go in.

Pour in coconut milk and add aubergine, cabbage and long beans. Simmer uncovered 10–12 minutes until everything is tender but the beans still have some bite. Add tofu puffs for the final 5 minutes to absorb the sauce.
Remove the lemongrass, add salt and lime juice, and rest 5 minutes. Serve the fragrant coconut curry with steamed rice.
tips: Use a clearly labelled vegetarian curry powder or paste. Add tender vegetables later so they do not turn mushy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mushroom Rendang

ingredients.name: oyster mushrooms, torn into large pieces

steps: Toast grated coconut in a dry pan for 5–7 minutes until deep golden, stirring constantly. Blend shallots, garlic, ginger, lemongrass and red chilies with a little coconut milk into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a wide heavy pan. Fry the paste for 8–10 minutes, stirring until it darkens and loses its raw smell. Add coriander and turmeric for the last minute.
Pour in remaining coconut milk. Add lime leaves, tamarind, palm sugar and salt, and simmer gently for 10 minutes to build a thick aromatic sauce.
Add torn oyster mushrooms and toasted coconut. Cook uncovered over medium-low heat for 25–30 minutes, stirring and scraping often as the liquid reduces and the mushrooms take on the spice paste.

Continue until the sauce clings darkly to the mushrooms and almost no free liquid remains. Remove lime leaves, rest 10 minutes and serve with rice; rendang should be a concentrated dry braise, not a soup.
tips: Use mushrooms with broad firm caps and a wide pan; slow reduction and toasted coconut create rendang's characteristic rich, nearly dry coating.

recipe.name: Gudeg

ingredients.name: young green jackfruit, drained and shredded
black tea leaves in a sachet

steps: Rinse canned or cooked young jackfruit thoroughly and shred the soft pieces with forks. Blend shallots, garlic, candlenuts or cashews and coriander with a little water to form a smooth spice paste.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and fry the paste for 5 minutes until aromatic. Add jackfruit and toss for 3 minutes so every strand is coated.
Add coconut milk, 250 ml water, palm sugar, galangal, bay leaves, salt and the tea sachet. Bring just to a simmer, cover and cook very gently for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Remove the tea sachet. Add tofu and tempeh and simmer uncovered for 25–30 minutes until the jackfruit is tender, reddish brown and the liquid has reduced to a moist coating. Turn the cubes carefully so they stay intact.
Discard galangal and bay leaves. Rest 10 minutes before serving with steamed rice; the palm sugar and slow cooking give gudeg its characteristic sweet, earthy flavour.
tips: Use young unripe jackfruit, not sweet ripe fruit. Tea deepens the colour; remove the sachet before its tannins make the dish bitter.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Tahu Bumbu Bali
steps: Press tofu for 15 minutes, then cut into 3 cm cubes and pat dry. Blend shallots, garlic, chilies, tomato, candlenuts or cashews and ginger into a rough red spice paste.
Heat 35 ml oil in a nonstick pan and fry tofu in batches for 6–8 minutes, turning until all sides are lightly golden. Set aside so its surface remains firm.
In the same pan add remaining oil and fry the spice paste for 8–10 minutes, stirring until it thickens, darkens and no longer smells raw.
Add bruised lemongrass, lime leaves, palm sugar, tamarind, 180 ml water and salt. Simmer 8 minutes until the sweet-sour sauce is glossy and thick enough to coat tofu.
Return tofu and turn gently in the sauce for 4–5 minutes. Remove lemongrass and lime leaves and serve with rice; the tofu should be coated in vivid red bumbu Bali rather than floating in gravy.
tips: Fry and dry the tofu first so it does not crumble when folded into the thick Balinese chilli sauce.

ingredients: long beans, cut into 5 cm lengths

recipe.name: Ginataang Kalabasa

ingredients.name: long beans, cut into 5 cm lengths

steps: Seed the squash and cut it into even 3 cm cubes, leaving tender skin on if using kabocha. Cut long beans into 5 cm pieces and keep separate so they are added later.
Heat oil in a wide pot. Cook onion for 4 minutes, then add garlic, ginger and green chilies and stir for 1 minute without browning the garlic.
Add squash, vegetable stock, half the coconut milk and salt. Cover and simmer gently for 10–12 minutes until squash is nearly tender but holds its shape.
Add long beans and remaining coconut milk. Simmer uncovered for 6–8 minutes until beans are tender-crisp and squash is fully cooked; do not boil vigorously or the coconut sauce may split.
Season with soy sauce and black pepper, rest 3 minutes and serve over rice. Use a clearly labelled vegetarian seasoning to keep this coconut stew plant-based.
tips: Use firm squash and add beans near the end; both should remain distinct in the creamy coconut sauce.

recipe.name: Kho Chay
steps: Press tofu for 15 minutes and cut into 3 cm cubes. Pat dry. Heat 25 ml oil and pan-fry tofu in batches for 7–8 minutes, turning until golden on several sides; remove.

Warm brown sugar with 20 ml coconut water in a small heavy pan over medium heat until amber, about 3–4 minutes. Carefully add remaining coconut water a little at a time; it will bubble, so keep hands clear.
In a clay pot or deep pan, heat remaining oil and cook shallots 3 minutes. Add garlic and shiitake and cook 4 minutes until the mushrooms begin to brown.
Pour in the caramel-coconut liquid and soy sauce. Add fried tofu, black pepper and salt. Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes, then uncover for 5 minutes to reduce the sauce to a glossy coating.
Turn tofu carefully, scatter spring onions over it and serve hot with plain rice. Use clearly labelled vegetarian soy sauce for the caramel braise.
tips: Do not stir the tofu vigorously during braising; gently turn the cubes so they stay intact and absorb the caramel-soy sauce.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Sri Lankan Cashew Curry
steps: Soak raw cashews in 250 ml warm water for 30 minutes, then drain. If using dried hard cashews, soak longer according to the packet so they cook through evenly.
Heat coconut oil in a heavy pan and soften onion for 5 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, green chilies, curry leaves and cinnamon; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in turmeric and roasted curry powder for 30 seconds. Add soaked cashews and remaining 150 ml water, cover and simmer gently for 12–15 minutes until the nuts begin to soften.
Pour in coconut milk and salt. Simmer uncovered for 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the cashews are tender and the pale golden sauce is creamy; avoid a hard boil.
Add green peas for the last 3 minutes. Remove cinnamon, rest 5 minutes and serve with rice or hoppers. The cashews should remain whole and plump, not blended into a paste.
tips: Start with raw unsalted cashews; roasted salted snack cashews will not soften into the traditional creamy kaju maluwa texture.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Sri Lankan Mango Curry
steps: Wash firm green mangoes and cut around each stone into thick wedges, keeping the peel on to help them hold their shape. Do not use soft ripe mangoes.
Heat coconut oil in a deep pan. Crackle mustard seeds, then add onion and curry leaves for 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add curry powder, turmeric and chilli with a splash of water and fry 1 minute. Add mango wedges, 180 ml water, sugar and salt, then cover and simmer 8–10 minutes until the mango begins to soften.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer uncovered for 8–10 minutes until the mango is tender but not collapsing and the sauce coats a spoon. Stir gently to avoid breaking the wedges.
Taste for sour-sweet balance, adding a little more sugar only if the mango is very tart. Rest 5 minutes and serve with rice and a mild dhal.
tips: Choose hard green mangoes; their acidity is the defining flavour, while a small amount of sugar rounds off excessive tartness.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Sri Lankan Soya Curry
steps: Cover dry soya chunks with 900 ml boiling water and soak 12 minutes. Drain, rinse well and squeeze out excess water; this removes the packaged taste and lets the chunks absorb curry.
Heat coconut oil in a deep pan. Cook onion 6 minutes until golden, then add garlic, ginger, chilies, curry leaves and cinnamon for 1 minute.
Stir in curry powder and turmeric for 30 seconds, then tomato. Cook 5–6 minutes until the tomato collapses and oil separates from the spice base.
Add squeezed soya chunks and toss 3 minutes to coat. Pour in 180 ml water and coconut milk, add salt, and simmer uncovered 12–15 minutes until the chunks are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove cinnamon, rest 5 minutes and serve with rice. Each chunk should be fully heated and saturated with the spiced coconut gravy.
tips: Squeeze the rehydrated chunks thoroughly; otherwise the curry can taste watery and the sauce will not penetrate.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Vegetarian Fesenjan
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss aubergine cubes with 30 ml oil and 4 g salt; spread in one layer and roast 25–30 minutes until browned and tender. Grind walnuts finely, stopping before they become butter.
Meanwhile heat remaining oil in a heavy pan and cook onion 8 minutes until golden. Stir in cinnamon and turmeric for 30 seconds.
Add ground walnuts and stir over low heat for 3 minutes, then pour in vegetable stock gradually while whisking. Simmer very gently 20 minutes, stirring often so the walnuts do not stick.
Stir in pomegranate molasses, brown sugar, remaining salt and black pepper. Simmer another 10 minutes until the sauce turns dark and thick; balance sourness with a little more sugar only if needed.
Fold roasted aubergine into the walnut sauce and warm 5 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, scatter pomegranate arils on top and serve with saffron rice.
tips: Keep the walnut sauce at a gentle simmer; a hard boil can scorch the nuts. Fesenjan is intentionally dark and sweet-sour from walnuts and pomegranate.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Egyptian Moussaka
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Slice aubergine into 1 cm rounds, brush with 45 ml oil and sprinkle with 5 g salt. Roast on lined trays for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until browned and flexible.
Meanwhile heat remaining oil in a pan. Cook onion and peppers 7–8 minutes until soft, then add garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in cumin, coriander and tomato paste for 1 minute. Add crushed tomatoes, remaining 6 g salt and black pepper; simmer uncovered 15 minutes until thick, then stir in half the parsley.
Layer half the aubergine in a shallow baking dish, spread with half the tomato-pepper sauce, and repeat. Press gently so the sauce reaches between slices.
Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes until bubbling and the top is lightly caramelized. Rest 10 minutes, scatter remaining parsley and serve with flatbread or rice; Egyptian mesa'ah has no béchamel layer.
tips: Roast aubergine before layering to avoid a watery casserole; this meatless Egyptian version relies on the rich tomato-pepper sauce.

recipe.name: Ghiveci
steps: Cut all vegetables into roughly 2–3 cm pieces, keeping potatoes and carrots separate from the softer zucchini and aubergine.
Heat oil in a heavy ovenproof pot. Cook onion 5 minutes, then add carrot, potato and bell pepper and cook 6 minutes, stirring until lightly coloured.
Add tomato paste and paprika and stir 1 minute. Add chopped tomatoes, stock, bay leaves, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Fold in aubergine and zucchini. Cover and bake at 190°C for 25–30 minutes, stirring once, until all vegetables are tender yet retain their shapes and the juices form a light tomato sauce.
Remove bay leaves. Rest 10 minutes, stir in parsley and serve warm with bread. Ghiveci is a chunky mixed-vegetable stew, not a blended purée.
tips: Add zucchini and aubergine after the firmer roots so they do not collapse before the potatoes cook.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Alboronía
steps: Cut aubergine and pumpkin into 2 cm cubes. Sprinkle aubergine with 3 g salt and rest 10 minutes, then pat dry. Toast almonds in a dry pan until golden and set aside.
Heat 40 ml olive oil in a broad pan and cook aubergine in batches for 7–8 minutes until browned. Remove; add remaining oil and cook onion and pepper 6 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, paprika and cumin for 30 seconds. Stir in pumpkin, tomatoes, 100 ml water and remaining salt; cover and simmer 12 minutes until pumpkin is nearly tender.
Return aubergine and simmer uncovered 8–10 minutes until the vegetables are soft but their cubes remain distinct and the tomato juices reduce. Stir in sherry vinegar.
Rest 5 minutes, scatter toasted almonds and serve warm with bread. Andalusian alboronía should taste gently sweet from pumpkin and bright from vinegar.
tips: Brown aubergine separately and fold it back late; this keeps the vegetables distinct rather than turning them into mash.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

steps: Remove pepper seeds and membranes and slice the flesh into long 1 cm strips. Slice onions thinly so they soften at a similar rate.
Heat olive oil in a broad pan over medium-low heat. Add onion and 4 g salt and cook 10–12 minutes, stirring, until soft and sweet but not dark.
Add pepper strips and remaining salt. Cook 12 minutes uncovered, turning often, until peppers begin to slump and shine. Add garlic for the final minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and black pepper. Cover and cook 10 minutes, then uncover for 5–8 minutes until the vegetables are silky and most watery juice has evaporated.
Stir in vinegar and torn basil off the heat. Rest 10 minutes before serving warm or at room temperature with bread or as a vegetable side.
tips: Cook peppers gently until silky rather than charring them; peperonata's sweetness comes from slow softened peppers and onions.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Tökfőzelék

ingredients.name: summer squash or marrow, coarsely grated

steps: Coarsely grate squash, sprinkle with 5 g salt and leave 10 minutes. Squeeze out excess water but do not press it dry; the strands should still be tender.
Melt butter in a deep pan over medium heat. Cook onion 5 minutes until translucent, then stir in paprika for 20 seconds without scorching.
Add grated squash and vegetable stock. Cover and simmer 8–10 minutes until the squash is soft but its strands are still visible.

Whisk sour cream with flour and a ladleful of hot cooking liquid until smooth. Lower the heat and stir this mixture into the squash; simmer 3–4 minutes, stirring, until lightly thickened, without a hard boil.
Add chopped dill, vinegar, remaining 5 g salt and black pepper. Rest 3 minutes and serve warm with bread. Tökfőzelék should be creamy and spoonable, not a smooth soup.
tips: Temper the sour cream with hot liquid before adding it to the pot, and keep the heat low so the sauce stays silky.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Mushroom Julienne
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Thinly slice mushrooms and onion. Melt 25 g butter in a broad pan and cook onion 5 minutes until soft.
Add mushrooms in batches and cook over medium-high heat for 8–10 minutes until their released water has evaporated and the edges begin to brown. Season with 6 g salt and pepper.
In a saucepan melt remaining 20 g butter. Stir in flour for 1 minute, then whisk in milk gradually and cook 3 minutes until smooth and thick. Lower heat and stir in sour cream without boiling.
Fold mushrooms and onion into the creamy sauce. Adjust with remaining 3 g salt, then divide among four small ovenproof dishes and cover with grated vegetarian cheese.
Bake 12–15 minutes until bubbling and golden on top. Rest 5 minutes, scatter parsley and serve with bread; Russian julienne is a baked creamy mushroom dish, not a matchstick knife cut.
tips: Cook the mushrooms until their liquid evaporates before adding sauce, or the individual baked dishes will turn watery. Use a clearly labelled vegetarian cheese.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

dish.name: Leek Gratin
ingredients: leeks, white and pale green parts

recipe.name: Leek Gratin

ingredients.name: leeks, white and pale green parts

steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Trim roots and dark green tops from leeks, halve lengthwise and rinse between layers to remove grit. Cut into 8 cm lengths.
Steam leeks 8–10 minutes until just tender, then drain very thoroughly and pat dry. Arrange in a buttered shallow baking dish in a single layer.

Melt 35 g butter in a saucepan. Stir in flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in milk. Cook 4–5 minutes until a smooth sauce coats a spoon. Stir in mustard, nutmeg, 6 g salt, pepper and half the cheese.
Pour sauce over the drained leeks. Mix breadcrumbs with remaining cheese and 15 g melted butter, then scatter evenly over the top.
Bake 20–25 minutes until the sauce bubbles and the top is golden. Rest 8 minutes before serving so the gratin holds together; serve with a green salad.
tips: Drain steamed leeks well because trapped water dilutes béchamel. Choose clearly labelled vegetarian cheese.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

dish.name: Gratin de Blettes
ingredients: Swiss chard, stems and leaves separated

recipe.name: Gratin de Blettes

ingredients.name: Swiss chard, stems and leaves separated

steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Wash chard thoroughly. Cut stems into 1 cm pieces and roughly chop leaves, keeping them separate because the stems take longer to cook.
Blanch stems in boiling water 5 minutes, add leaves for the last 2 minutes, then drain and squeeze out as much water as possible. Spread in a buttered baking dish.
Melt 35 g butter in a saucepan and soften onion for 5 minutes. Add flour and stir 1 minute, then whisk in milk gradually; simmer 4 minutes until thick and smooth.
Season the béchamel with nutmeg, salt and pepper and stir in half the vegetarian cheese. Pour over the chard, gently lifting the vegetables so sauce reaches underneath.
Mix breadcrumbs with remaining cheese and 15 g melted butter and scatter over the dish. Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbling and golden, then rest 8 minutes before serving.
tips: Cook chard stems before leaves and squeeze both thoroughly; excess water makes the béchamel gratin thin. Use clearly labelled vegetarian cheese.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

ingredients: butternut squash, peeled and thinly sliced

recipe.name: Butternut Squash Gratin

ingredients.name: butternut squash, peeled and thinly sliced

steps: Heat oven to 190°C. Peel and seed squash, then slice into even 3 mm pieces. Butter a shallow baking dish with 15 g butter.
Melt 10 g butter in a pan and cook onion 7 minutes until soft; stir in garlic and thyme for 1 minute. Whisk cream, milk, salt, pepper and nutmeg together.
Layer half the squash in the dish, overlapping slices. Scatter half the onion and one-third of the cheese over it; repeat with remaining squash and onion.
Pour cream mixture evenly over the layers. Cover tightly with foil and bake 30 minutes until a knife meets only slight resistance in the squash.
Mix breadcrumbs with remaining cheese and 10 g melted butter. Remove foil, scatter topping and bake 15–20 minutes until deeply golden and squash fully tender. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.
tips: Slice squash thinly and evenly so the centre cooks before the cheese browns; choose clearly labelled vegetarian cheese.
